name: OpenJazz
description:
OpenJazz is a free, open-source game engine reimplementation of Jazz Jackrabbit, the fast-paced 1994 platformer by Epic MegaGames. It allows players to enjoy the high-speed adventures of the green hare on modern Linux.

Features:
- Native cross-platform execution with smooth 60 FPS side-scrolling action
- Scalable high-resolution graphics and widescreen presentation
- Full support for modern controllers, gamepads, and customizable keyboard layouts
- Local split-screen multiplayer racing and battle modes
- Compatible with shareware, floppy, and CD-ROM releases of Jazz Jackrabbit
